pages.text: Every spent Fuel Rod becomes a $(l)Depleted Fuel Rod$(): nuclear waste. Left untreated it makes the area around it $(l)radioactive$(). Treat it in a $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l).

Radiation builds up chunk by chunk (16x16 columns of the world):$(br)$(li)Depleted Fuel Rods $(l)carried$() by a player, $(l)stored$() in a chest or any container (storage blocks of other mods included), or $(l)lying on the ground$(): every rod adds a little every few seconds.
pages.title: What contaminates

pages.text: $(li)A Fission Reactor whose $(l)waste slots are full$(): the spent rods wait in the core and it $(l)leaks$().$(br)$(li)A $(l)meltdown$(): heavy contamination over a 5x5 chunk area, worst at the core.
Radiation fades away by itself over a few minutes once the source is gone; a meltdown site takes much longer. Waste inside the reactor's waste slots or a Waste Reprocessor is shielded.

$(li)$(l)below 20 Rad$(): harmless$(br)$(li)$(l)20 Rad$(): $(l)Radiation Sickness I$(): hunger and damage every 3 seconds$(br)$(li)$(l)100 Rad$(): $(l)Radiation Sickness II$(): also weakness, damage more often
pages.title: What it does

pages.text: $(li)$(l)300 Rad$(): $(l)Radiation Sickness III$(): also nausea, damage almost every second$(br)$(li)$(l)50 Rad and more$(): the land $(l)withers$(): grass dries to dirt, plants wilt into dead bushes, leaves fall

Radiation Sickness hits players and mobs alike and goes through normal armor. A $(l:nuclear/hazmat_suit)Hazmat Suit$(/l) keeps it out, and a $(l:nuclear/hazmat_suit)Geiger Counter$(/l) tells you how much there is. Withering land can be turned off in the common config ($(o)Radiation Withers Land$()).
